g.text: Vacancy applications — from applying to the team, and what the admin reads

text.tspan: Viewed — first time the author or a project admin
(a platform admin opening it counts for nothing)

g.text: Is it their own submitted application?

text.tspan: project · status · listing payment · applications · dates · views
viewed by the project · chat: opened · author last read · closed

ul.li: An applicant is never a team member: the team holds only Founder, Hired and Fired.
Every existing application moves, submitted and rejected, with its dates; no member is lost.
Only the candidate withdraws their own application; the author hires or rejects.
A closed application never reopens its chat, and never auto-joins anyone.
"Viewed" is set by the project's author or admins, never by a platform admin, and only a platform admin reads it.
The admin page changes nothing; the listing payment is read as recorded, none means free.
